# Autoconnecto

> Autoconnecto is a multi-tenant IoT SaaS platform (India) for real-time device monitoring, remote control, alarms, and automation.

- Support: support@autoconnecto.in

## Primary differentiator

Attribute-based control with feedback: shared attributes set desired state; devices confirm via client attributes. After power cycle, devices restore from retained shared attributes—the dashboard stays aligned with hardware without operators re-sending commands.

## Pricing (INR, indicative)

Free, Hobby, Starter, Growth (white-label), Enterprise — see https://www.autoconnecto.in/pricing
